title: workflow_run on pytest-run cancelled or zero-tests-collected: rerun once (run_attempt==1)
note: [2026-10-13 AUTO-WAVE1] .github/workflows/pytest-rerun.yml (workflow_run on pytest-run) + scripts/ci/pytest_rerun.py. Reruns ONCE per head sha only when the Run tests step was cancelled at the job timeout (timeout read from pytest-run.yml minus 3 min) or the job died before tests started; never a failed test step, a superseded head, or attempt >1. Built, not yet observed live.

observation.what: AUTO-PYTEST-RERUN built and measured against its estimate
observation.how_to_check: cancel a run on a scratch PR: exactly one rerun, then its own result stands
